Geometry_and_Silhouette: Multi-story rectangular form built into cliff face.
Flat roofs with stepped profile following rock ledge.
Structure nestled under natural rock overhang.

Wooden vigas (roof beams) protruding from walls.
Ladder access points to upper levels.
Material_and_Context: Rough-hewn stone blocks bound with mud mortar in earth tones (tan, brown, reddish).
Adobe plaster surfaces with characteristic cracking patterns.
Built into sheltered cliff ledges providing weather protection.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Flowing A-line or cape-like shape draping from shoulders to knees or ankles.
No sleeves; open front or fastened at neck.
Vertical folds with minimal wrinkling from heavy fabric weight.

Collar may be high-standing, hooded, or flat.
Hemline exhibits even drape with slight flare.
Material_and_Context: Heavy fabric (wool, velvet, or fur-lined) with smooth or textured surface.
Fabric creates soft vertical draping lines.
No visible seams on front panel; single-piece drape construction.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Thick, substantial wooden sole with carved contour matching foot shape.
Upper portion covers toe and instep as single piece.

Decorative perforations or painted patterns on upper.

Leather or textile upper material.
Dutch geta show elevated platform with fabric thong; sabots show carved single-block construction.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Tall cylindrical or conical metallic container, noticeably taller than a standard drinking glass.
Two-piece (Boston) or three-piece (cobbler) construction.
Weighted base provides stability.

Removable cap on lid.
Threaded or snap-fit connection with rubber gasket seal.
Material_and_Context: Stainless steel or chrome-plated with polished reflective surface.
Brushed or mirror finish with horizontal seam lines.
Measurement markings may be etched on exterior.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Cylindrical vessel of standard drinking size, noticeably taller than it is wide.
C-shaped handle attaching at upper and lower thirds of body.
Rounded or slightly flared rim with unglazed foot ring base.

Exterior may display printed graphics, text, or solid color glaze.

Curved spout extending from upper body at an acute upward angle.

C-shaped or loop handle attached opposite spout.

Wire diameter ranges from hair-thin to substantially thick.

Cross-section shows circular or rectangular profile.
Visible winding direction along spiral.
Material_and_Context: Metallic (copper, steel) with characteristic luster, or insulated with colored polymer coating.
Surface texture is smooth.
Material appears as continuous wound wire, tubing, or strip.

Shackle arching from top as a slender, hardened steel U-bar.

Alignment indicator (arrow or line) marks correct combination position.
White numerals on dark background.

Hardened steel shackle.
Compact padlock-style security device.

Grid of raised keys in QWERTY layout.
Elongated space bar, noticeably wider than any individual key, at bottom center.

Function key row (F1-F12) at top.
Modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) at edges.
Connection cable extends from top or rear, or wireless variant shows no cable.

Characters printed white on black or black on white.
